description: §6.7.4 negative twin: an `<effect deps=[@n]>` that lists a cell is NOT E-EFFECT-NO-DEPS.
rationale: §6.7.4: "`deps=` is REQUIRED and SHALL list at least one cell" — one listed cell satisfies it. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "`when` → outside-world effects only, spelled `<effect>`" — "your recs, except expound 3b, specifically why the engine restriction."
